svg.title: Projecting onto an e-flat submanifold
svg.desc: Left: level sets of KL[P:Q] in the probability triangle, an e-flat line S (a straight line in the logit chart, curved here) and the m-geodesic from P to its projection P-hat on S. Right: KL[P:Q(s)] along S and KL[P:P-hat] + KL[P-hat:Q(s)] lie on top of each other (largest gap 1.5e-08); the minimum is 0.3984.
svg.text: level sets of KL[P : Q] over Q, and the line S
along S: KL[P:Q(s)] and KL[P:P̂] + KL[P̂:Q(s)]
S: a straight line in θ (e-flat)
m-geodesic from P to its projection P̂, meeting S at a right angle (in the Fisher metric)
the two curves coincide: largest gap 1.5e-08
because S is e-flat, Pythagoras holds for every Q on S,
so the only critical point is the minimum
